N2-runtime-headers.note: BetterAuth Cookie session is NEVER required from phone and MUST NOT be forged. Home validates ht1_* server-side (sessions JOIN devices, SHA-256, expiry/revocation; client user_id rejected), maps 1:1 via upstream_users, asserts via vendor patch server/src/home-bridge.ts (HMAC v2.{id}.{exp}.{role}.{nonce}.{mac}, ME_HOME_BRIDGE_SECRET>=32c, 60s TTL, single-use nonces, role allowlist).
